verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships its own programmatic surfaces: an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions server via `edge0 serve`, a CLI with flags such as --no-lora and --no-prerouter, and a Python AutoEngine API. It also ships desktop and mobile apps, but nothing shows those APIs cover everything the apps can do. missing for 10: documented UI-to-API feature parity, API coverage of model download and adapter management beyond chat completions, an API reference, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: macOS: local CLI / daemon / desktop app (Rust)
